description: This is a main activity Java source file for an Android application. It sets up a basic UI, manages a fragment, and handles menu actions including toggling a log view display. It also initializes logging components for debug purposes.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity class that extends SampleActivityBase. It manages UI initialization, menu handling, and logging setup.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets the layout and initializes fragment on first creation.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from resource.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the menu, toggling visibility and title based on internal state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection, toggling log view display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain with custom log nodes and filter, and links it to a log display fragment.
